description: This file defines a PHP trait 'CryptoParamsTrait' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling cryptographic parameter logic related to S3 client operations, including material providers, instruction file suffixes, and metadata strategies.

methods.name: getMaterialsProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the MaterialsProvider instance from the arguments, or throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getInstructionFileSuffix
methods.description: Returns the instruction file suffix parameter from arguments or default.

methods.name: determineGetObjectStrategy
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate metadata strategy based on object metadata.

methods.name: getMetadataStrategy
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate metadata strategy object based on arguments.
